name: Zenet Thunder Fall
effectText: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you control a Normal Monster or a "Zenet" Ritual Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 "Zenet" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY, except "Zenet Thunder Fall". You can only use each effect of "Zenet Thunder Fall" once per turn.
